231: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ; ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
They do not realise the essence of reality; they gather bundles of straw. ॥2॥
The self-willed ones, in ignorance, take the evil path.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
They forget the Lord's Name, and insist on all sorts of rituals.
They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, through the love of duality. ॥3॥
Dependent on Maya, he calls himself a pandit;
imbued with corruption, he suffers terrible pain.
ਜਮ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜਾ; ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
The noose of death is around his neck; death torments him constantly. ॥4॥
The Messenger of Death does not come near the Gurmukh;
he burns away ego and duality through the Word.
Imbued with the Name, he sings the Lord's praises. ॥5॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾਸੀ; ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Maya is the servant of the Lord's devotees, and works for them.
One who falls at their feet attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
He is forever immaculate, absorbed in poise. ॥6॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਹਿ; ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Those who listen to the Lord's sermon are seen to be wealthy in this world.
ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਹਿ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
Everyone bows down to them, and honours them day and night.
ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
With intuitive ease, they cherish the praises of the True Lord within their minds. ॥7॥
The perfect True Guru has revealed the Word;
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ; ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
erasing the three qualities, one's consciousness is attached to the fourth state.
O Nanak, subduing ego, one is united with God. ॥8॥4॥
(The pandit) reads the Veda of Brahma and engages in argument,
but darkness is within him, and he does not understand his own self.
God is found when one chants the Guru's Word. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
I serve the Guru; then death does not devour me again.
The self-willed ones are consumed by the love of duality. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through the Guru, even sinners are reformed;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੀਧੇ ॥
through the Guru's Word, they are steeped in poise within.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
They have found my God; through the Guru's Word they are made whole. ॥2॥
Those whom the True Guru unites, God Himself unites with Himself;
ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
they are pleasing to the mind of my True Lord God.
They sing the Lord's praises with intuitive ease and love. ॥3॥
Without the True Guru, people are deluded by doubt.
The blind self-willed ones eat poison continually.
ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਹਿ; ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
They are struck by the rod of death, and suffer pain forever. ॥4॥
ਜਮੂਆ. ਨ ਜੋਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
The Messenger of Death does not even look at one in the Lord's sanctuary;
subduing ego, he is lovingly attuned to the True One.
ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
He remains forever attuned to the Lord's Name. ॥5॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are immaculate and pure.
ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
Merging their mind with (the Guru's) mind, they conquer the whole world.
ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਤੇਰੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੬॥
In this way, you too shall find peace, O my friend. ॥6॥
One who serves the True Guru obtains the fruit:
the Name dwells in his heart, and self-conceit departs from within.
The unstruck melody of the Word resounds within him. ॥7॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ. ਨ ਸੀਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Who has not been made whole through the True Guru, O my brother?
Through devotion they are made whole, and obtain honour at His door.
O Nanak, in the Lord's Name is glory. ॥8॥5॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ; ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
One who speaks of the three qualities — his doubt does not depart.
ਬੰਧਨ. ਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
His bonds are not broken, and he does not find liberation.
The True Guru is the Giver of liberation in this age. ॥1॥
The Gurmukh mortal is rid of doubt;
ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the melody of poise wells up within, as he is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ; ਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
Those in the three qualities are under the command of death;
232: they do not remember the Name of the Creator Lord.
They die and are reborn, over and over again. ॥2॥
ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ; ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
From a blind guru, doubt does not depart.
Abandoning the Source, people are attached to the love of duality.
ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
Intoxicated with poison, one is absorbed in poison. ॥3॥
Taking Maya as the source, people wander in doubt.
They have forgotten the Dear Lord, in the love of duality.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
One upon whom He casts His glance of grace attains the supreme status. ॥4॥
(The Guru) reveals the Truth within, and the Truth outside as well.
ਸਾਚੁ. ਨ ਛਪੈ; ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਛਪਾਏ ॥
The Truth cannot be hidden, even if someone tries to hide it.
The spiritually wise understand this, with intuitive ease and love. ॥5॥
The Gurmukh remains lovingly attuned to the True Lord.
Through the Word, he burns away ego and Maya.
My True Lord God unites him in union with Himself. ॥6॥
The True Guru, the Giver, imparts the Word;
he holds back the wandering mind and keeps it in check.
Understanding is obtained from the perfect Guru. ॥7॥
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ; ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
The Creator Himself created the universe, and He Himself destroys it.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Without Him, there is no other at all.
O Nanak, how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this. ॥8॥6॥
The Gurmukh obtains the priceless Name.
He serves the Name, and through the Name he is absorbed in poise.
With his tongue he continually sings the Ambrosial Name.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
One upon whom the Lord shows mercy obtains the sublime essence of the Lord. ॥1॥
Night and day, I meditate on the Lord of the universe within my heart.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਉ; ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਸੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru, I have obtained the supreme status of peace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Peace is in their hearts, and they are enlightened —
the Gurmukhs who sing of the True Lord, the Treasure of virtue.
They become the slaves of the Lord's slaves, day after day.
Living with their household and family, they remain ever detached. ॥2॥
How rare is the Gurmukh who becomes liberated while yet alive;
he alone obtains the supreme treasure.
Erasing the three qualities, he becomes pure.
With intuitive ease, he is absorbed in the True One, and meets God. ॥3॥
ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
There is no attachment or love for family
when the True Lord dwells within the heart.
The mind of the Gurmukh is pierced (with love) and becomes steady;
he recognises the Lord's command, and understands the True Lord. ॥4॥
ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ; ਮੈ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
You are the Creator; for me there is no other.
ਤੁਝੁ ਸੇਵੀ; ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
I serve You, and through You I obtain honour.
If You show mercy, then I sing Your praises, O God.
ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ; ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੫॥
The jewel of the Name is the light throughout the whole world. ॥5॥
To the Gurmukh, the Bani seems sweet.
His heart blossoms forth; night and day he is lovingly attuned.
By (the Guru's) grace, he meets the True One with intuitive ease.
The True Guru is found through perfect, great good fortune. ॥6॥
Ego, possessiveness, evil-mindedness and pain are destroyed
when the Lord's Name, the Treasure of virtue, dwells in the heart.
Through the Guru, the intellect is enlightened, by the praise of God,
when one dwells on Him in the heart, and abides at His feet. ॥7॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
He alone obtains the Name, to whom it is given.
The Gurmukh, whom He unites, sheds self-conceit.
He enshrines the True Name within his heart.
O Nanak, he is absorbed in the True One with intuitive ease. ॥8॥7॥
ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ; ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
The mind has been adorned from within, in the fear of God, with intuitive ease and love.
233: Through the Word, the mind is dyed (with His love), lovingly attuned.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
It dwells in its own true home, in the will of God. ॥1॥
Serving the True Guru, pride departs,
and the Lord of the universe, the Treasure of virtue, is found. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
The mind becomes detached when, through the Word, it partakes of the fear of God.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਸਭ ਤੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
My God is immaculate; He is pervading everywhere.
By the Guru's grace, one is united in His union. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
The slave of the Lord's slaves finds peace.
ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
My Lord God is found in this way.
ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
By the Lord's grace, one sings the Lord's praises. ॥3॥
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਹੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ. ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Cursed is that long life in which love for the Lord's Name does not arise.
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ; ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Cursed is the comfortable bed of a woman, in the dark of attachment.
ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ; ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Fruitful is the life of those who take the Name as their support. ॥4॥
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Cursed, cursed is the household and family in which love for the Lord does not arise.
ਸੋਈ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ; ਜੋ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
He alone is my friend who sings the Lord's praises.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਮੈ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੫॥
Without the Lord's Name, there is no other for me. ॥5॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਮ; ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
From the True Guru I have obtained salvation and honour.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਦੂਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
I have meditated on the Lord's Name, and all my pain is erased.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
I am in bliss forever, lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ॥6॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ; ਹਮ ਕਉ. ਸਰੀਰ ਸੁਧਿ ਭਈ ॥
Meeting the Guru, I have come to understand the body.
The fire of ego and craving has been completely quenched.
Anger is gone, and I have grasped forgiveness. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
The Lord Himself shows mercy, and bestows the Name.
How rare is the Gurmukh who receives this jewel.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥੮॥੮॥
Nanak sings the praises of the unseen, inscrutable Lord. ॥8॥8॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰੇ; ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖ. ਬੁਰੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥
Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru are seen to be faithless and evil.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਵੇਲਾ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
Bound, they are beaten day and night; they shall not get this chance again. ॥1॥
O Lord, please shower Your mercy and save me.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O God, unite me with the true congregation, that I may cherish the Lord's virtues within my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ; ਜੋ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੰਨਿ ॥
Those devotees are pleasing to the Lord who, as Gurmukhs, walk in His love.
ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨਿ; ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਏ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
Renouncing self-conceit, they serve, and remain dead while yet alive. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
The body and breath of life belong to Him; His command is over every head.
ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ. ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Why forget Him from the mind? Keep the Lord enshrined in the heart. ॥3॥
ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ. ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Receiving the Name, one obtains honour; believing in the Name, there is peace.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
The Name is obtained from the True Guru; by His grace, God is met. ॥4॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ, ਜੋ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ; ਓਇ ਭ੍ਰਮਦੇ. ਨਾ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru keep wandering and never find stability.
ਧਰਤਿ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ. ਨ ਝਲਈ; ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਏ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
Neither the earth nor the sky will bear them; they rot in filth. ॥5॥
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ; ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
This world is deluded by doubt; it has taken the drug of attachment.
ਜਿਨਾ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਭਿਟੈ ਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Maya does not even come near those who have met the True Guru. ॥6॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Those who serve the True Guru are beautiful; they shed the filth of ego.
234: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ. ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
Those who are imbued with the Word are immaculate; they walk in harmony with the True Guru's will. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
O Lord God, You alone are the Giver; You Yourself forgive and unite us with Yourself.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
Servant Nanak seeks Your sanctuary; as it pleases You, save him. ॥8॥1॥9॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਰਹਲੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ; ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
O camel-like wandering mind, a stranger here — how will you meet the Lord, your Mother?
ਗੁਰੁ. ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
When, by perfect destiny, one finds the Guru, the Beloved comes and embraces him. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O camel-like mind, meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
O camel-like mind, be thoughtful, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.
ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
Where the account is called for, the Lord Himself will release you. ॥2॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਇ ॥
O camel-like mind, you were utterly pure, but the filth of ego has stuck to you.
ਪਰਤਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
The Beloved Husband is manifest in the home of your own heart, right with you, yet separated from Him, you suffer blows. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਇ ॥
O camel-like mind, my beloved, search for the Lord within your heart.
ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ. ਨ ਲਭਈ; ਗੁਰੁ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
He cannot be found by any device; the Guru shows the Lord within the heart. ॥4॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ; ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
O camel-like mind, my beloved, day and night be lovingly attuned to the Lord.
ਘਰੁ ਜਾਇ. ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ; ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
You shall go home and find the Mansion of love, when the Guru unites you with the Lord. ॥5॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਤੂੰ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥
O camel-like mind, you are my friend; abandon hypocrisy and greed.
ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
The hypocrite and the greedy are struck down; death punishes them with his rod. ॥6॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤੂੰ; ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
O camel-like mind, you are my breath of life; rid yourself of the filth of hypocrisy and doubt.
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ. ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
The perfect Guru is the pool of the Lord's nectar; joining the congregation, the filth is washed away. ॥7॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
O camel-like mind, my beloved, listen to the one teaching of the Guru:
ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ; ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
this attachment to Maya is spread out everywhere; in the end, nothing shall go along with anyone. ॥8॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
O camel-like mind, my good friend, one who has taken the Lord as provisions obtains honour.
ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
He is robed in honour in the Court of the Lord, and the Lord Himself hugs him close. ॥9॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
O camel-like mind, one who surrenders to the Guru becomes Gurmukh and works for the Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ. ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
Offer your prayers to the Guru, O servant Nanak; He will unite you with the Lord. ॥10॥1॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ; ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
O thoughtful camel-like mind, reflect and look carefully.
ਬਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀਆ; ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
The forest-dwellers have grown weary of wandering in the forests; through the Guru's teaching, behold your Husband Lord within your heart. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ; ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O camel-like mind, dwell on the Guru and the Lord of the universe. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
O thoughtful camel-like mind, the self-willed are caught in the great net.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
The Gurmukh mortal is liberated, dwelling on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥2॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
O camel-like mind, my beloved, seek the true congregation and the True Guru.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Joining the true congregation, meditate on the Lord, and the Lord, Har, Har, shall go along with you. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
O very fortunate camel-like mind, the Lord casts one glance of grace,
235: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
When He Himself releases us, we are released, cherishing the feet of the True Guru. ॥4॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
O camel-like mind, my beloved, cherish the Divine Light within the body.
ਗੁਰਿ. ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆਲਿ ॥੫॥
The Guru has shown me the nine treasures of the Name; the merciful Lord has blessed me with this gift. ॥5॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਤੂੰ ਚੰਚਲਾ; ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਿ ॥
O camel-like mind, you are so fickle; abandon your cleverness, which leads to the dreadful pit.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ; ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
Dwell on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; at the very last moment, the Lord will liberate you. ॥6॥
ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ. ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ; ਤੂੰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
O very fortunate camel-like mind, cherish the jewel of spiritual wisdom.
ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ. ਹਥਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ; ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
One who holds in hand the sword of the Guru's wisdom slays death with this slayer of death. ॥7॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ. ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
The treasure is within you, O camel-like mind, yet you wander in doubt, searching outside.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧੜਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੮॥
Meeting the perfect Guru, the Primal Being, I found the Lord, my Friend, right with me. ॥8॥
ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜੇ. ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
O camel-like mind, dyed in (worldly) pleasures, cherish the Lord's love forever.
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੯॥
The Lord's love never fades; serve the Guru and cherish the Word. ॥9॥
ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਕਾਲਿ ॥
O camel-like mind, we are birds; the Lord, the Timeless Being, is the tree.
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
The very fortunate Gurmukhs find Him; O servant Nanak, cherish the Name. ॥10॥2॥
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਬ ਇਹੁ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
When this person takes pride in his mind,
he wanders around like a madman, a stranger to all.
ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਹੂਆ; ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
But when he becomes the dust of all,
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਮਈਆ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
he recognises the Lord in each and every heart. ॥1॥
The fruit of humility is intuitive peace and pleasure;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੈ; ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
my True Guru has blessed me with this gift. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ; ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
When he believes others to be bad,
then everyone seems to lay traps for him.
But when he stops thinking of "mine and yours",
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
then no one is angry with him. ॥2॥
When he clings to "my own, my own",
ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ; ਹੈ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
But when he recognises the Creator Lord,
ਤਬ ਇਸ ਨੋ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
When he binds himself in attachment,
he comes and goes, forever watched by death.
ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ; ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
But when all his doubts are dispelled,
there is no separation between him and the Supreme Lord God. ॥4॥
ਜਬ ਇਨਿ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੂਖ; ਡੰਡ ਅਰੁ ਖੇਦਾ ॥
he suffers pain, punishment and sorrow.
But when he recognises the One and only Lord,
ਤਬ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੋ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੫॥
When he runs around seeking Maya,
he is not satisfied, and his thirst is not quenched.
ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ; ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਜਉਲਾ ॥
But when he runs away from it,
Maya (Lakshmi) gets up and follows him. ॥6॥
When, by His grace, the True Guru is met,
the lamp is lit in the temple of the mind.
When one realises what victory and defeat truly are,
ਤਉ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕੀ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੭॥
then one appreciates the value of this home (the body). ॥7॥
236: The One Lord is the Doer, the Cause of all causes.
He Himself is wisdom, contemplation and discernment.
ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਨੇਰੈ; ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
He is not far away; He is near at hand, with everyone.
Praise the True One, O Nanak, with love. ॥8॥1॥
Serving the Guru, one is committed to the Name.
ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
It is received only by those with good destiny on their foreheads.
The Lord dwells in their hearts,
and their minds and bodies become calm and steady. ॥1॥
O my mind, sing such praises of the Lord,
ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ; ਜੋ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
which will be of use to you here and hereafter. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Meditating on Him, fear and misfortune depart,
and the wandering mind is held steady.
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Meditating on Him, suffering never strikes again.
Meditating on Him, this ego runs away. ॥2॥
Meditating on Him, the five passions are overcome.
Meditating on Him, nectar is gathered in the heart.
Meditating on Him, this craving is quenched.
Meditating on Him, one is approved in the Court of the Lord. ॥3॥
Meditating on Him, millions of sins are erased.
Meditating on Him, one becomes holy, blessed by the Lord.
Meditating on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed.
Meditating on Him, all filth is washed away. ॥4॥
Meditating on Him, the jewel of the Lord is obtained;
ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲੈ ॥
one does not abandon Him again, but stays bonded with the Lord.
Meditating on Him, one abides as if in many heavens.
Meditating on Him, one dwells in peace and poise. ॥5॥
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਇਹ ਅਗਨਿ. ਨ ਪੋਹਤ ॥
Meditating on Him, this fire (of craving) does not touch one.
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਇਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਜੋਹਤ ॥
Meditating on Him, death does not even look at one.
Meditating on Him, your forehead shall be spotless.
Meditating on Him, all pain is gone. ॥6॥
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਬਨੈ ॥
Meditating on Him, no difficulty arises.
Meditating on Him, one hears the unstruck melody.
Meditating on Him, one earns this pure reputation.
Meditating on Him, the heart-lotus is turned upright. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
The Guru has bestowed His glance of grace upon all
ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
within whose hearts He has implanted the Lord's mantra.
The unbroken kirtan of the Lord's praise is their sweet food and nourishment —
says Nanak, those who have the perfect True Guru. ॥8॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
One who enshrines the Guru's Word within his heart
cuts away his connection with the five (passions).
He keeps the ten organs under his control,
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
upon whom God bestows His mercy and grace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
Friend and foe are one and the same to him.
Whatever he hears is the Name.
He awakens in poise, and sleeps in poise.
That which is meant to be, happens in poise.
In poise he remains detached, and in poise he laughs.
In poise he remains silent, and in poise he chants. ॥3॥
In poise he eats, and in poise he loves.
In poise all his duplicity is erased.
In poise he joins the company of the holy.
In poise he meets the Supreme Lord God, without hesitation. ॥4॥
He is in poise within his home, and in poise while detached.
237: In poise, the duality of his body is dispelled.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ; ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
One whose mind is filled with bliss in poise
meets the Lord of supreme bliss. ॥5॥
In poise he drinks in the Ambrosial Name.
In poise he gives the gift of (spiritual) life to others.
His soul delights in the sermon of poise.
The Imperishable Lord abides with him. ॥6॥
In poise he is pleased by his stable seat.
In poise the unstruck melody of the Word resounds.
In poise the tinkling melody is beautiful.
The Supreme Lord God is contained within his home. ॥7॥
One who is blessed with grace, in poise,
meets the Guru in poise, and makes the True One his religion.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ; ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Only one in whom poise has arisen knows it.
Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ॥8॥3॥
First, one emerges from dwelling in the womb;
then one becomes attached to children, wife and family.
One enjoys food of many kinds, and many clothes,
but the poor wretches shall surely depart. ॥1॥
ਕਵਨੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ; ਜੋ. ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥
What is that place which never perishes?
ਕਵਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ; ਜਿਤੁ. ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
What is that Word by which evil-mindedness is removed? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the realm of Indra, death is certain.
The realm of Brahma shall not remain permanent.
The realm of Shiva shall also perish.
The three qualities, Maya and the demons shall pass away. ॥2॥
ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਧਰਣਿ; ਗਗਨ ਅਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
The mountains, the trees, the earth, the sky and the stars;
the sun, the moon, the wind, fire and water;
day and night, fasts and their distinctions;
the Shastras, the Simritees and the Vedas shall pass away. ॥3॥
Sacred shrines, gods, temples and holy books;
rosaries, ceremonial marks, purified cooks and burnt offerings;
loincloths, prostrations and enjoyment of sacred foods —
all of these, and all people, shall pass away. ॥4॥
Social classes and castes, Muslims and Hindus;
beasts, birds and the many species of beings —
the whole expanse that is seen,
the whole visible world, shall pass away. ॥5॥
Through the praise of the Lord in poise, through devotional worship and the essence of spiritual wisdom,
eternal bliss and the imperishable true place are obtained.
There, in the company of the holy, the Lord's virtues are savoured.
There, the city of fearlessness is forever inhabited. ॥6॥
ਤਹ ਭਉ ਭਰਮਾ; ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
There is no fear, doubt, sorrow or anxiety there;
there is no coming or going, and no death there.
There is eternal bliss, and the unstruck melody resounds there.
The devotees dwell there, with the kirtan of the Lord's praises as their support. ॥7॥
There is no end or limit to the Supreme Lord God.
Says Nanak, when the Lord showers His mercy,
the imperishable home is obtained; in the holy company, one is carried across. ॥8॥4॥
One who kills this (duality) is a spiritual hero.
One who kills this is perfect.
One who kills this obtains glorious greatness.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
One who kills this is freed of suffering. ॥1॥
ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ; ਜਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
How rare is such a person, who kills and casts off duality.
ਇਸਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ; ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Killing it, he attains union with God while living as a householder. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
238: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
One who kills this has no fear.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
One who kills this is absorbed in the Name.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
One who kills this has his craving quenched.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝੈ ॥੨॥
One who kills this is approved in the Court of the Lord. ॥2॥
One who kills this is wealthy.
One who kills this is honourable.
One who kills this is truly celibate.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਤੀ ॥੩॥
One who kills this attains salvation. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
One who kills this — his coming (into the world) is approved.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
One who kills this is steady and wealthy.
One who kills this is very fortunate.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
One who kills this remains awake and aware, night and day. ॥4॥
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
One who kills this is liberated while yet alive.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
One who kills this lives a pure lifestyle.
One who kills this is spiritually wise.
ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੫॥
One who kills this meditates with intuitive ease. ॥5॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
Without killing this, one is not acceptable,
even though one may perform millions of rituals, chants and austerities.
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
Without killing this, one does not escape the cycle of reincarnation.
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜਮ ਤੇ. ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥੬॥
Without killing this, one does not escape death. ॥6॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Without killing this, one does not obtain spiritual wisdom.
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧੋਈ ॥
Without killing this, one's impurity is not washed off.
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
Without killing this, everything is filthy.
ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਉਲਾ ॥੭॥
Without killing this, everything is a losing game. ॥7॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
When the Lord, the Treasure of mercy, bestows His mercy,
ਤਿਸੁ ਭਈ ਖਲਾਸੀ; ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
one obtains release, and attains total perfection.
ਗੁਰਿ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
One whose duality has been killed by the Guru —
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
When one is linked with the Lord, then everyone is a friend.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
When one is linked with the Lord, the consciousness is steady.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾੜੑਾ ॥
When one is linked with the Lord, one is not afflicted by worries.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ; ਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
When one is linked with the Lord, one is emancipated. ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
O my mind, unite yourself with the Lord.
Nothing else is of any use to you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The great and powerful people of the world
are of no use at all, you fool!
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ; ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ॥
The Lord's servant may be heard to be of humble birth,
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
but in his company, you shall be saved in an instant. ॥2॥
ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Hearing His Name is equal to millions of cleansing baths.
ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਜਾ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
Meditating on Him is equal to millions of worship ceremonies.
ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁੰਨ; ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Hearing the Word of the Lord's Bani is equal to millions of acts of charity.
ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Knowing the way through the Guru is equal to millions of rewards. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥
Within your mind, remember Him over and over again,
and your attachments to Maya shall depart.
The imperishable Lord is always with you.
ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਰਚੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
O my mind, be immersed in the love of the Lord. ॥4॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਉਤਰੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ॥
Working for Him, all hunger departs.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਨ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਦੂਤ ॥
Working for Him, the Messenger of Death does not watch over you.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਤੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਗਮਰੁ ॥
Working for Him, you shall obtain glorious greatness.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ; ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਮਰੁ ॥੫॥
Working for Him, you shall become immortal. ॥5॥
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ; ਨਹੀ ਡਾਨ ॥
His servant does not suffer punishment.
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ; ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨ ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਫਤਰਿ; ਪੁਛੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
In His court, no account is asked of him.
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਊਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ॥
He is not lacking in anything.
He Himself is One, yet appears in so many forms.
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਹੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
By His glance of grace, one is forever happy.
ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਕਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੭॥
O my mind, do the work of serving Him. ॥7॥
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਤੁਰੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
No one is clever, and no one is foolish.
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੀਣੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
No one is weak, and no one is a hero.
239: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ; ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
As the Lord attaches someone, so is he attached.
He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed by destiny. ॥8॥6॥
Without remembering the Lord in meditation, one's life is like that of a snake.
So does the faithless cynic live, forgetting the Name. ॥1॥
ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ; ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
One who lives in meditative remembrance even for an instant
ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਾਖ; ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lives as if for hundreds of thousands and millions of days, and becomes stable forever. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without remembering the Lord in meditation, one's actions and works are cursed.
Like the crow's beak, one dwells in filth. ॥2॥
Without remembering the Lord in meditation, one acts like a dog.
The faithless cynic is nameless, like the son of a prostitute. ॥3॥
Without remembering the Lord in meditation, one is like a horned ram.
The faithless cynic barks out lies, and his face is blackened. ॥4॥
Without remembering the Lord in meditation, one is like a donkey.
The faithless cynic wanders around in polluted places. ॥5॥
Without remembering the Lord in meditation, one is like a mad dog.
The greedy faithless cynic falls into entanglements without restraint. ॥6॥
Without remembering the Lord in meditation, one murders one's own soul.
ਸਾਕਤ ਨੀਚ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੭॥
The faithless cynic is wretched, without family or social standing. ॥7॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
When the Lord becomes merciful, one joins the true congregation.
Says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world. ॥8॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮੋਹਿ. ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the supreme status.
The perfect Guru has preserved my honour. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, I have obtained a place of rest. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਸੁਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
I listen to the Guru's Word, and chant it with my tongue.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
By the Guru's grace, my speech is like nectar. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, my self-conceit has been erased.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
Through the Guru's kindness, I have obtained great glory. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, my doubt has been dispelled.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੪॥
Through the Guru's Word, I see God everywhere. ॥4॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, I practise union with God while living in the world.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੫॥
In the Guru's company, the whole world is saved. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, my affairs are resolved.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥੬॥
Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the treasure of the Name. ॥6॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ; ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
Those who place their hope in my Guru
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
have the noose of death cut away. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਜਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, my good destiny has awakened.
O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I have met the Supreme Lord God. ॥8॥8॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ॥
I remember that Guru with each and every breath.
ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru is my breath of life; the True Guru is my wealth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru, I live.
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
I wash the Guru's feet, and drink in this water. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ; ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's feet,
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਰਉ ॥੨॥
and the filth of ego from countless lifetimes is washed away. ॥2॥
I wave the fan over that Guru,
ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ; ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
who gave me his hand and saved me from the great fire. ॥3॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਢੋਵਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
I carry water for the household of that Guru,
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
from whom I have learned the way of the indivisible Lord. ॥4॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਪੀਸਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
I grind the corn for the household of that Guru,
by whose grace all my enemies have become friends. ॥5॥
240: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Guru who gave me (spiritual) life
has Himself purchased me and made me His humble slave. ॥6॥
He Himself has blessed me with His love.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
Forever and ever, I bow in humility to that Guru. ॥7॥
ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ; ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
My troubles, sorrows, fears, doubts and pains have been dispelled;
says Nanak, my Guru is all-powerful. ॥8॥9॥
ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ; ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
Meet me, O my Lord of the universe; please bless me with Your Name.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, cursed, cursed is all love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without the Name, whatever one wears and eats
is like the dog that sticks its mouth in impure food. ॥1॥
are useless, like decorations on a dead body. ॥2॥
One who forgets the Name and indulges in pleasures
ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ; ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
finds no peace, even in dreams; his body becomes diseased. ॥3॥
One who renounces the Name and engages in other affairs —
all his false pretensions shall fall away. ॥4॥
ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
One whose mind does not embrace love for the Name
shall go to hell, even though he performs millions of rituals. ॥5॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਮਨਿ ਨ ਆਰਾਧਾ ॥
One whose mind does not worship the Name of the Lord
ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ; ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੬॥
is bound like a thief in the City of Death. ॥6॥
Hundreds of thousands of ostentatious displays and great expanses —
without the Name, all these displays are false. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
That humble being alone repeats the Lord's Name,
O Nanak, whom the Lord blesses with His mercy. ॥8॥10॥
The One who stands by me in the beginning, in the middle and in the end —
my mind longs for that Friend. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
The Lord's love goes with us forever.
The perfect, merciful Lord cherishes all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He shall never perish, and He shall never abandon me.
Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading. ॥2॥
He is beautiful, all-knowing, the most clever, the Giver of life.
God is my brother, son, father and mother. ॥3॥
He is the support of my life and breath; He is my wealth.
Abiding within my heart, He inspires me to enshrine love for Him. ॥4॥
The Lord of the world has cut away the noose of Maya.
Gazing upon me with His glance of grace, He has made me His own. ॥5॥
Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, all diseases are cured.
Meditating on His feet, all comforts are enjoyed. ॥6॥
The perfect Primal Lord is ever-fresh and ever-young.
Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord is with me as my Protector. ॥7॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨ ॥
Says Nanak, one who realises the state of the Lord, Har, Har —
the devotee is blessed with the treasure of the Name. ॥8॥11॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਅਸੰਖ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
Countless people wander around searching, but they do not find His limits.
They alone are His devotees, who are blessed by His grace. ॥1॥
I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਡਰਾਉ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭੈਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
Hearing again and again that the path is terrifying, I was so very afraid.
ਮੈ ਤਕੀ ਓਟ ਸੰਤਾਹ; ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
I have taken the shelter of the saints; please save me! ॥2॥
